purpose: Turn Elementor JSON source evidence into deterministic whole-page visual-target predictions plus reproducible pinned-baseline WordPress/Elementor controlled-runtime evidence with source validation, official Template Library import, semantic importer roundtrip, registered widget inventory, cross-browser responsive rendering, DOM layout snapshots, same-site media identity contracts and native Elementor Website Template/Design System export-import evidence for exact supported runtimes. Optional Elementor Pro is run-resolved unless an explicit version constraint is introduced and is therefore evidenced only for the exact installed version captured in that run's runtime inventory.

caller.surface_rule: Chat web/desktop may use the exposed GitHub connector and remote GitHub Actions runtime. This does not imply local repository, terminal, WP-CLI or target-site access. Local or target claims still require their own surface/preflight.
caller.qa_handoff: website-qa-checklist for staging/live/browser acceptance beyond this disposable controlled runtime

required_when: new or screenshot-reconstructed Elementor JSON needs a runtime or visual claim
existing Elementor JSON changes structure, widgets, widget settings, responsive behavior or dependencies
the user asks to test, scan, model, render, preview, screenshot, verify widgets, verify Pro or check import behavior
source-valid JSON is about to be described as runtime-valid, importer-valid or visually correct
a V4 Design System, Global Classes/Variables package, mixed V3/V4 Website Template or native package roundtrip is about to be described as exportable or importable
optional_when: the task is a source-only audit or planning task and no runtime, importer, visual or native-package claim is needed
forbidden_when: input contains secrets, credentials, personal data or client-confidential content; private repository visibility is not permission to persist target data or secrets
the task requires exact target-site IDs or target compatibility without target inventory or staging evidence
the task is a production or live-site mutation

why: build a deterministic whole-page source prediction before visual inspection and preserve uncertainty as explicit, declared, inferred or unknown
detect malformed Classic or Atomic Elementor structures before import
detect missing or unavailable Elementor widgets before target import
check JSON against widgets and controls registered by a real Elementor runtime
exercise Elementor's documented Template Library importer instead of treating direct postmeta writes as import proof
detect semantic importer drift while ignoring only volatile Elementor element IDs
prove that WordPress and Elementor can render the importer-produced template data in a disposable environment
produce Chromium, Firefox and WebKit evidence at desktop, tablet, mobile and active breakpoint boundaries
capture computed DOM geometry/layout metadata next to screenshots so visual review can check alignment, dimensions, gaps, overflow and responsive behavior against the source prediction

exercise Elementor's own import-export-customization component and its registered native runners when exact-runtime V4 Classes/Variables or mixed package evidence is required, instead of inventing ZIP internals
prove same-site Image, Background and Basic Gallery attachment id+url readback separately from portable import media migration
separate source-prediction, controlled-runtime and target evidence

before_run: read runtime-contract.json from main and verify repository, branch, workflows and evidence role
classify editor family, dependency mode, target objects and risk with the Elementor skill
sanitize public-repository inputs and keep secrets outside committed files
write or update the canonical test JSON under templates/
build a visual-target artifact from the complete JSON before section-level repair; attach a matching safe design-intent sidecar when available
optionally provide target/inventory.json only when it is sanitized and safe for this public repository
for native V4 package evidence, activate the exact required Elementor experiments before Elementor boot so customization import/export runners register in that runtime
run: let the Page Composition Contract workflow build source-prediction visual targets and composition reports
let the Elementor JSON QA workflow start from the main change or workflow_dispatch

when native Website Template/Design System evidence is in scope, let the Native Elementor Kit Contract workflow exercise the documented V3 CLI route plus Elementor's import-export-customization component for V4/mixed packages
resolve the resulting workflow runs and require the relevant jobs to complete successfully
readback: read visual-targets and composition-audit artifacts and confirm visual-target evidence_class=source_prediction and render_observed=false
check dependency audit, runtime inventory, source/runtime/deep audits, importer roundtrip reports, render manifests and Elementor Pro status
for native-package claims, read native-elementor-kit-contract artifacts including V4/mixed ZIP file lists, export/import reports, same-site media readback and evidence-summary.json
inspect Chromium, Firefox and WebKit desktop/tablet/mobile screenshot metadata including layout_snapshot before making a controlled-runtime browser/layout claim
record open target, editor reopen/save/re-export, accessibility and staging tests separately
iterate: on a confirmed source, dependency, importer, roundtrip, native-package or render defect, repair the canonical source/capability and rerun the same evidence layer
on a visual mismatch, compare the whole-page visual-target prediction plus screenshot/layout snapshot, repair the smallest confirmed section cause, rebuild the whole-page target and rerun
never convert source-prediction or controlled-runtime success into target_verified or production_observed without later evidence

inputs.design_intent: sidecars/<template>.design-intent.json (optional and only when sanitized and safe to persist in the generic runtime repository)
inputs.target_inventory: target/inventory.json (optional and only when sanitized; confidential target inventories remain outside the generic repository and require an ephemeral target-specific evidence channel)
inputs.elementor_pro_secret: ELEMENTOR_PRO_LICENSE_KEY (optional GitHub Actions secret; never commit the value)
inputs.reference_visual: kept outside this public repository when confidential; used by the calling assistant for comparison
inputs.native_kit_scope: exact runtime include keys for the Elementor import-export-customization component; defaults must never be treated as target-site capability proof

baseline.dependency_policy: direct npm versions are exact; npm audit blocks high/critical findings; a committed npm lockfile remains required for a fully immutable npm dependency graph; optional Elementor Pro is resolved from Elementor's official Composer repository per run unless an explicit version constraint is added, and the exact installed Pro version must be taken from runtime-inventory.json for any Pro-specific claim

pipeline: validate this runtime contract and repository contracts
build and schema-check a whole-page visual-target source prediction with explicit/declared/inferred/unknown provenance labels
run source-level classic/widget auditor and deep Classic/Atomic structural validator
run validator, visual-target and semantic-roundtrip unit tests
audit npm dependencies and fail on high/critical findings
start pinned disposable WordPress/PHP with wp-env
install pinned Elementor Core and Hello Elementor
optionally install and activate Elementor Pro from Elementor's official Composer repository and use the exact installed version captured in runtime-inventory.json as run-specific provenance
export the registered Elementor widget and control inventory and verify pinned runtime versions
audit every source template against the runtime and optional sanitized target inventory
import every source template through wp elementor library import
export the newest imported library item's semantic document data and compare it against source while ignoring only volatile element IDs
audit the importer-produced JSON again
render importer-produced JSON into isolated Elementor Canvas pages
run Chromium, Firefox and WebKit browser checks at desktop, tablet, mobile and active breakpoint boundaries with reduced-motion, console, request, image and overflow checks
capture full-page screenshots plus DOM layout snapshots with element bounding boxes and computed layout/style properties

when native package evidence is in scope, keep wp elementor kit export as the documented legacy V3 CLI contract and use the generic EJL native_kit_export/native_kit_import bridge to Elementor's current import-export-customization component for registered V4/mixed runners
for V4 package evidence, verify exact feature states, Global Class and Variable export contents, native import readback and re-export persistence

for media identity evidence, create live disposable WordPress attachments and prove same-site Image, Background and Basic Gallery id+url readback while treating portable import ID remapping as a separate migration behavior
upload audit reports, visual targets, importer outputs, runtime inventory, render manifests, Pro status, native-kit reports/ZIPs and screenshots/layout metadata as workflow artifacts
deactivate the temporary Pro license when used and destroy the runtime
outputs: native-elementor-kit-contract/native V3/V4/mixed ZIPs and export/import reports

can_support: deterministic whole-page source prediction with explicit/declared/inferred/unknown provenance and unresolved-field disclosure
Classic and documented Atomic source-structure validation within implemented validator scope
runtime widget availability in the disposable environment
successful Elementor Template Library importer acceptance
semantic preservation of content and page_settings across importer storage while ignoring only volatile element IDs
successful disposable WordPress/Elementor render of importer-produced JSON
Chromium, Firefox and WebKit checks at the configured desktop, tablet, mobile and active breakpoint viewports
observed DOM bounding boxes and computed layout/style metadata for rendered Elementor elements in that disposable runtime
native Elementor 4.3.1 customization export/import/re-export of Global Classes and Variables when their required features were active at boot
mixed V3/V4 Website Template package behavior in the exact disposable runtime
same-site WordPress attachment id+url preservation for the tested Image, Background and Basic Gallery controls
does_not_prove: the visual-target source prediction is a screenshot, browser observation or pixel-perfect truth
editor reopen/save or a target/UI re-export roundtrip
site-specific object IDs, target globals, Classes/Variables, conditions or dynamic data
the same V4 package capability on a target where version, feature states or registered runners differ
portable media attachment IDs remaining identical after import; Elementor may migrate media and allocate new IDs
Elementor Pro behavior when the Pro secret was not present for the run
cross-run Elementor Pro version reproducibility when Pro was resolved without an explicit version constraint
pixel-perfect visual equivalence without an approved reference baseline

iteration.on_failure: Repair only confirmed JSON, dependency, importer, roundtrip, native-package, render or layout defects; never invent unknown Atomic, Pro, add-on or site-object data; rebuild the whole-page visual target and rerun the same affected evidence layers.
iteration.on_visual_mismatch: Compare the current whole-page visual-target prediction with screenshot and layout_snapshot evidence, adjust only the smallest confirmed section/component cause, then rebuild and rerun; keep already-passed scope frozen unless the change can affect it.
iteration.formal_final_gate: After the last implementation change, require two stable green final rounds for the covered controlled-runtime scope before handoff to staging/QA.

privacy.rule: Do not commit confidential client JSON, private screenshots, credentials, license keys, personal data, secret URLs or confidential target inventories. Private repository visibility is not a waiver; use sanitized fixtures or an ephemeral target-specific runtime/evidence channel instead.
privacy.secret_handling: ELEMENTOR_PRO_LICENSE_KEY must exist only as a GitHub Actions secret and must never be logged or committed.
